text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road fell just short of 
victory. The winner was—Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Narita Top Road managed to show 
her hope. Her tenacious running became the 
catalyst to change Admire Vega, who had 
intended to throw everything away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it was for "her" sake, then to ensure 
she wouldn't be forgotten—perhaps she 
needed to run toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho drew to a bright close. 
Yet, that was only the beginning of Act 
Two— the Tenno Sho (Spring) was waiting 
for her.
